gen.title: Limits and Military Context of the Proclamation

cards.stem: Which area did the Emancipation Proclamation directly cover as a wartime measure?
options: states that had seceded from the Union
loyal states that never left the Union
areas of the Confederacy already occupied
cards.quote: It applied only to states that had seceded from the Union, leaving slavery untouched in the loyal border states.
cards.hint: Think about which states the wartime order could legally reach.

cards.stem: How was the Proclamation described that explains its limited reach?
cards.quote: Because it was a military measure, however, the Emancipation Proclamation was limited in many ways.
cards.hint: Consider the legal basis Lincoln claimed during the war.

cards.stem: What service did the Proclamation open to Black men after that date?
cards.quote: Moreover, the Proclamation announced the acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy, enabling the liberated to become liberators.
cards.hint: Recall the new opportunity announced for formerly enslaved people.

cards.stem: What did the promised freedom depend upon for effect?
options: a ruling by England and France
cards.quote: Most important, the freedom it promised depended upon Union military victory.
cards.hint: Remember what was needed to make the promise real.
